recommendation: Completeness critic, OP-D2. Three concrete gaps, all quantified, none closeable from the current vault: (1) NO VIX-conditioned family (F01,F02,F06,F11,F13[REFUTED-dead],F14,F16,F17,F18,F20,F21,F22) sees the 2008 GFC -- the India VIX vault starts 2010-07-23, so the 362 NIFTY trading days 2008-01-01..2009-06-30 that ARE in the NIFTY vault (2007-09-17..2026-04-13) never enter any VIX-state, HMM-vs-VIX, condor, or decay statistic. F14's 'half-life MISSES the 15-40d bar: median 2 days (n=25 episodes, 2011-2023)' is therefore an upper bound on how fast a genuine multi-quarter panic decays -- its only in-sample crisis is COVID (a single V-shaped month), not a GFC-length regime. F16/F17/F18's condor sims and Kelly f* are calibrated on the same crisis-light window (F18 caveat's own words: 'DD probabilities... iid ignores vol clustering so real DD odds are worse -- the constrained f values are upper bounds' -- extend that logic to the missing GFC tail itself, not just the iid assumption). (2) NO VIX-conditioned family sees the 743 NIFTY trading days after the VIX vault's 2023-04-05 tail (through today 2026-09-07) -- this window contains the 2024 general-election spike (RUNSHEET.md line 16: 'Still owed from the NSE primary: the 2009 head, post-Apr-2023 tail (2024 election spike)... and option-chain IV') AND, per research/frontier/manager-frontier-sweep.md's breaks-registry (C2), the SEBI 2024-26 derivatives curbs (contract size Rs15-20L, weekly-expiry rationalization, upfront premium, expiry tail-margin) -- a DATED STRUCTURAL BREAK that the sweep note itself says 'every derivatives-adjacent design (H60-VRP, FS-D1, H58 family) must era-split at.' F16/F17/F18 were run on 2011-07..2023-04 data with NO era-split because the break postdates their entire sample -- so their condor management rules, margin-proxy sizing, and Kelly f* describe a pre-curb microstructure that per the breaks-registry may no longer exist; this is not merely 'stale', it may be describing a regime that has since changed. (3) NO family in this sweep touches a real option chain: F13 (VIX-vs-fwd-RV, IV-HV spread) uses the VIX INDEX as an implied-vol proxy, never a traded strike; F15/F16/F17/F18 are explicit Black-Scholes analytic constructions -- f15/f16/f17 caveats state verbatim 'no smile/skew', 'no transaction costs or slippage', 'margin proxy = max wing width - credit' / 'margin proxy = max loss'. This means: (a) put/call skew asymmetry in real NIFTY index options (well-documented, ignored by flat-sigma=VIX BS) is untested and could shift F15's stated theta/gamma/vega ratios and F16/F17's wing pricing asymmetrically; (b) real bid-ask/slippage costs are zero in every sim, so F16's 32.2% mean cost and F17's ruin-inducing wipe are BEST-CASE execution numbers; (c) real strike granularity (index options trade at discrete strikes, not the continuous 1.0/2.5-sigma BS wings used) is untested; (d) real SPAN+exposure margin (vs the 'max wing width - credit' proxy) is untested, which directly changes F18's Kelly-fraction-to-capital-usage translation. NEXT DATA NEEDS, exact and in priority order: (i) NSE India VIX primary pull via ingest/pull_india_vix.py --emit-auth-template, spanning the 2009 head through 2026-09 tail (closes both the GFC-adjacency gap on the front end AND the election-spike/SEBI-curb gap on the back end) -- principal-machine only, NSE blocked from this environment; (ii) NSE option-chain IV snapshots (strikes, bid/ask, OI) named explicitly in RUNSHEET.md line 16 as 'owed... for FS-D1/VRP' and in manager-frontier-sweep.md line 51 as 'Options-chain data gated (runsheet)' blocking H60-VRP's registration -- without it, F13/F15/F16/F17/F18 cannot be upgraded past BS-analytic/VIX-proxy status. Until (i)+(ii) land, F14/F16/F17/F18's numeric bars (MISS/PASS as printed) should be read as descriptive of the 2011-23, pre-SEBI-curb, no-GFC regime only, and the H60-VRP design brief must carry an explicit era-split caveat per the breaks-registry (C2), not just a sample-size caveat. Also unresolved from the individual PARTIAL verdicts (not re-litigated here, just flagged as still-open before any promotion): f06's undocumented 200-DMA magic-number provenance, f07's t=-7.179 vs headline's '-7.2' and the missing purge/embargo caveat (quant/stats/cv.py exists and is unused per process note #6), f09's 11-episode concentration (top-2=50% of washout days) with bootstrap p=0.002 vs permutation-null p=0.044, f10's doji_fwd5d failing family-wise Bonferroni (t=2.471 < crit~2.75) while 3down_fwd5d survives, f13's REFUTED groupby.first() leak (n=142 should be 141 -- treat as dead per instructions, though c3/c5 headline numbers are independently confirmed unaffected), f19's headline mislabeling CW-D1a as CW-D1v, f20's PASS cells reducing to 1-2 extreme-month flags (effective n=1-2, not decile-wide), f21's wrong-sibling citation (F16 vs actual F01/F11) for its <50th-pct grid point.
